changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[RuleImplementations_All] AS select R.RuleTypeID, RT.Name as RuleType, D.ID as AssetID, I.RuleID, AD.DisplayValue as [Rule], I.ID as RuleImplementationID, coalesce(I.Name, 'Implementation ' + cast(I.ID as nvarchar)) as RuleImplementation, I.SourceID, I.SourceUri, count(Q.ID) as QualifierCount, I.CreatedOn, I.CreatedBy, I.UpdatedOn, I.UpdatedBy from RuleImplementation I left join RuleResultQualifierType Q on Q.RuleImplementationID = I.ID inner join [Rule] R on R.ID = I.RuleID inner join dbo.Asset D on D.Object = 'Rule' and D.ObjectID = R.ID inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue AD on AD.AssetId = D.ID inner join RuleType RT on RT.ID = R.RuleTypeID group by R.RuleTypeID, RT.Name, D.ID, I.RuleID, AD.DisplayValue, I.ID, coalesce(I.Name, 'Implementation ' + cast(I.ID as nvarchar)), I.SourceID, I.SourceUri, I.CreatedOn, I.CreatedBy, I.UpdatedOn, I.UpdatedBy
